subject: Pop-up runway: kit allocation and rapid setup plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Event Logistics <ops@atlaslogistics.com>, SaaSConf Venue Coordinator <venue@sasconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pop-up runway: kit allocation and rapid setup plan

Hi Atlas / Venue team,

We're confirmed for a 10'x20' 'runway' pop-up at SaaSConf (booth R-14). The space is narrow with a single 6' service corridor and a 4' sightline gap — this impacts where we can stage rollcases and do a rapid load-in. Attaching our latest floorplan (redwood_floorplan_runway_10x20_v2.pdf).

As we finalize logistics, can you do three things: 
- Review the attached floorplan and confirm ingress/egress constraints for large crates (48" x 40").
- Share a 1-page rapid-setup checklist for a 4-person crew (we need <8 min set-up per kit).
- Confirm whether Atlas can pre-stage 3 'spare' rollcases at the dock and tag them for our lead.

Marissa, copying you for kitting alignment — see the sketch in the manifest. Karthik, tagging you for AV drop and power placement (we may need to shift the demo pedestal ~2ft so the line-of-sight isn't interrupted).

Thanks — want to lock this by Friday so we can finalize print and signage.

Evelyn Hart
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood_floorplan_runway_10x20_v2.pdf

From: Atlas Event Logistics <ops@atlaslogistics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SaaSConf Venue Coordinator <venue@sasconf.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up runway: kit allocation and rapid setup plan

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks for the floorplan — reviewed with the load-in team. Quick notes: 
- Dock access: 10/20 has a single dock window for halls B/C; max pallet footprint is 48"x40". We can handle three pre-staged rollcases if you provide the manifest and contact for the lead (we'll tag them and keep them at Dock 3).
- Narrow corridor: the 6' service corridor allows one fork or two hand-truck passes; we'll recommend hand-truck for speed.
- Rapid-setup checklist: attached a 1-page setup playbook (we're sending a vendor-side checklist as 'atlas_rapid_setup_playbook.pdf' in the vendor portal). Key items: position base pedestals first, run power snake along left sightline, secure backdrop with grommets at 6ft, leave 3ft demo clearance.

Open questions for you: 
1) Confirm weight of each demo case (to advise labor team).
2) Do you want Atlas to apply pre-printed booth numbers on the rollcases? (helps show crew where cases go).

We can pre-stage at no extra charge if we get manifest by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Maya Singh
Ops Lead, Atlas Event Logistics
ops@atlaslogistics.com | +1 206-555-3267

Attachments referenced: atlas_rapid_setup_playbook.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Atlas Event Logistics <ops@atlaslogistics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up runway: kit allocation and rapid setup plan

Thanks Maya — helpful. A few follow-ups from our side: 

1) Kitting manifest: attached 'kitting_manifest_proposed.csv' — each kit is ~72 lbs (main case), demo pedestal is 28 lbs, and AV saddle case 48 lbs. Total per kit ~148 lbs split across 3 cases.

2) Signage/fascia: I'm attaching the final fascia art (fascia_art_v3.pdf). Note: the fascia height must stay below 8.5ft per venue rule; the backdrop in our floorplan was drawn at 9ft. Can we aknowledge margin and plan for a 1-hand-truck lift to secure the top crossbar instead of using a ladder? 

3) Staffing: Proposed crew = 1 lead (supervisor), 2 pushers (rollcase), 1 tech (AV). That meets Atlas' <8 min target if we do a two-sided parallel unload (Dock → staging → interior).

Karthik — can you confirm the power drop shown on the floorplan (near the south edge) is still our preferred location? If we shift the pedestal 2ft north, it will give us cleaner sightlines into the runway but might create a cable run that crosses the primary footpath. Thoughts?

Marissa Cole
Senior Field Producer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-1122

Attachments: kitting_manifest_proposed.csv, fascia_art_v3.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Event Logistics <ops@atlaslogistics.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pop-up runway: kit allocation and rapid setup plan

On Tue, Oct 19, 2026 at 2:02 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik — can you confirm the power drop shown on the floorplan (near the south edge) is still our preferred location?

Checked with AV partners — power drop at south edge is fine but we should keep the cable runs off the main aisle. Proposal: shift the demo pedestal 18" north (not 2ft) to give a 6" buffer; then run a low-profile cable ramp across the back of the demo zone (will not impede attendees). That keeps sightlines and meets venue ADA rules.

Also: add 3 spare rollcases (tagged SPARE-1/2/3) to the manifest and confirm Atlas will pre-stage them at Dock 3. Atlas — if you can confirm pre-stage and tag by EOD Thursday, we'll finalize printing and give you a contact on-site (Lead: Jordan Blake, +1 415-555-0134).

I'll update the floorplan with the 18in shift and upload — sending updated link to drive once done.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Events Engineering, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 312-555-4430
